hypotheses.justification: The conclusion still holds when ε ≤ 0. Then ε/2 ≤ 0 and mass u P ≥ 0 by `mass_nonneg u hu P`, so the left side is ≤ 0. The right side satisfies 0 ≤ mass u Q, again by `mass_nonneg u hu Q`. When 0 < ε, the existing proof works unchanged. A proof would do `by_cases 0 < ε`. The first case uses the current term. The second case uses `mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg` (or nlinarith) together with `mass_nonneg`. `hu` is still available. This can be deleted on its own, and also together with hR.

The conclusion still holds when R ≤ 0. By `mass_weight_mono w u hle P` and hP, mass u P ≤ mass w P ≤ R ≤ 0. If ε ≥ 0, then ε/2 * mass u P ≤ 0 ≤ mass u Q, using `mass_nonneg u hu Q`. If ε < 0, then ε/2 * mass u P ≤ 0 because mass u P ≥ 0 by `mass_nonneg`. When R > 0, the existing proof works unchanged. A proof would do `by_cases 0 < R`. This can be deleted on its own, and also together with hε. In every case where either is dropped, the remaining sign facts still give LHS ≤ 0 ≤ RHS.
